description: This file contains unit tests for custom grain activators in an Orleans-based application. It demonstrates how to implement and verify a custom grain activator that bypasses dependency injection, tracks grain disposal, and applies to specific grain types.

classes.name: GrainActivatorTests
classes.description: Unit test class for testing custom grain activator behavior in Orleans.

classes.name: Fixture
classes.description: Test fixture class for setting up Orleans test cluster with custom configuration.

classes.name: HardcodedGrainActivator
classes.description: Custom implementation of IGrainActivator that creates grains with hardcoded dependencies and tracks disposal count.

methods.description: Configures the Orleans test cluster with initial silo count and custom configurator.

methods.name: Configure

methods.description: Constructor for the test class, initializes the fixture.
